name: PageNumbers
description: A collection of PageNumber objects that represent the page numbers in a single header or footer.
remarks: Use the PageNumbers property to return the PageNumbers collection. The following example starts page numbering at 3 for the first section in the active document. Use the Add method to add page numbers to a header or footer. The following example adds a page number to the primary footer in the first section. To add or change page numbers in a document with multiple sections, modify the page numbers in each section or set the LinkToPrevious property to True. Use PageNumbers (_index_), where _index_ is the index number, to return a single PageNumber object. In most cases, a header or footer contains only one page number, which is index number 1. The following example centers the first page number in the primary header in the first section.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified PageNumbers object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of page numbers in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: NumberStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdPageNumberStyle constant that represents the number style. Read/write.

properties.name: IncludeChapterNumber
properties.description: True if a chapter number is included with page numbers or a caption label. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HeadingLevelForChapter
properties.description: Returns or sets the heading level style that's applied to the chapter titles in the document. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ChapterPageSeparator
properties.description: Returns or sets the separator character used between the chapter number and the page number. Read/write WdSeparatorType.

properties.name: RestartNumberingAtSection
properties.description: True if page numbering starts at 1 again at the beginning of the specified section. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: StartingNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the starting note number, line number, or page number. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ShowFirstPageNumber
properties.description: True if the page number appears on the first page in the section. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DoubleQuote
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word encloses the specified PageNumbers object in double quotation marks ("). Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual PageNumber object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([PageNumberAlignment As Variant], [FirstPage As Variant]) As PageNumber
methods.description: Returns a PageNumber object that represents page numbers added to a header or footer in a section.

parameters.name: FirstPage
parameters.description: False to make the first-page header and the first-page footer different from the headers and footers on all subsequent pages in the document. If FirstPage is set to False, a page number isn't added to the first page. If this argument is omitted, the setting is controlled by the DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter property.
